names.note: The heading of days.pravoslavie.ru’s name page 13745, «Константин (Лебедев), иерей, сщмч.», with the two rank words after the comma left off. The day line gives only «Константина пресвитера», the forename and the rank in the genitive, so the surname is the name link’s and is stored with it. `fk.mjs` returns no holder for «константин лебедев»; the corpus’s four other Lebedevs are Alexander, Alexis, Anastasia and Demetrius.

death.note: The year the day line prints after his name, «(1918)». No year of birth, no age and no place is given on either the day page or the name page, and no life page exists.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 9 июля ст. ст. — «Сщмч. Константина пресвитера (1918).»

attestations.note: The day’s seventh entry. THE CALENDAR GIVES NO LIFE: the line links to his name and to no reading, and name page 13745 prints the heading, «Дни памяти: 26 января (Новомуч.) , 9 июля» and nothing else. `new-martyr` rests on that first day — the synaxis the page itself labels «(Новомуч.)» — standing beside this one, which is his own, together with «sщмч.» grading him a martyr on both line and page. THE 26 ЯНВАРЯ DAY PAGE WAS NOT OPENED. `office` is «Priest», the page’s «иерей», one of the words the four locale packs carry. No hymn on the day page stands under his name. azbyka.ru was not read.
